scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You arrive at the agency office before the viewing in Madrid. You need to check in, confirm that the appointment is for the right flat, and understand how the visit will start. You are renting with a small child, but family details are not discussed here.
Learner: Tenant. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: room details, rent and deposit, documents, who will live in the flat, next steps after the viewing.
must_say: give your name — slot: the name
say why you are there — slot: the purpose
ask whether the flat is still available — slot: the flat
ask how long the viewing will take — slot: none
answer whether you have rented before — slot: the place or time
ask where to start — slot: none
must_understand: asks for your name and whether you have an appointment
says the flat is available and the agent will show it
asks whether this is your first rental in the area
tells you how the viewing will go and where to begin

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You are viewing the apartment with the agent in Madrid. This is the key interaction because you must decide whether the flat works for your situation and whether your small child can live there comfortably. What you understand here affects whether you continue with the application.
Learner: Tenant. Partner: Real estate agent.
Not in this scene: checking in at the office, handing over documents, filling forms, signing a contract, paying money.
must_say: ask about the rent — slot: the flat
ask what is included in the rent — slot: the cost
ask how many rooms there are — slot: the room type
ask whether something is allowed — slot: the thing (a child, a pet)
say who will live in the flat — slot: the person or pet
ask whether there is a problem with something — slot: the thing (noise, light, heating)
ask how far something is — slot: the place (school, metro)
ask whether the flat can be reserved — slot: the flat
must_understand: says the rent, the deposit and what is included
asks who will live in the flat
says the number of rooms and basic features
explains a condition or limitation of the flat
tells you the next step if you want the flat

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: After the viewing, you decide to move forward and speak with the agent about the application. You need to understand the required papers, how to send them, and when you may get an answer. This is still before any contract signing.
Learner: Tenant. Partner: Real estate agent.
Not in this scene: first check-in, room details, rent discussion, living conditions in the flat, signing the lease.
must_say: say you want the flat — slot: the flat
ask which documents are needed — slot: the application
ask when the decision will be made — slot: none
ask how to send the documents — slot: the documents
answer whether you can provide a document — slot: the document
ask whether a payment is needed now — slot: the payment
confirm what you will send — slot: the document set
must_understand: says which documents are required
asks whether you can provide proof of income or identification
explains how and when to send the documents
says when you will get an answer
says whether any payment is needed before approval
